source: GitHub REST compare, read-only, captured 2026-11-02 for JesusFilm/lantern; non-secret repository content. Diff is the application/vnd.github.diff response restricted to three files; files are the matching entries of the JSON files list.

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+name: Independent review
+
+# Runs trusted code from main on pull_request_target. It never checks out or executes pull request code;
+# the harness reads the diff through the GitHub API and publishes the "Independent review" check as the
+# dedicated GitHub App. See docs/operations/review-gate.md.
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: independent-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  run-review:
+    if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    environment: ai-review
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          ref: main
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Run independent review
+        env:
+          AI_REVIEW_APP_ID: ${{ vars.AI_REVIEW_APP_ID }}
+          AI_REVIEW_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.AI_REVIEW_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          AI_REVIEW_GATEWAY_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.AI_REVIEW_GATEWAY_BASE_URL }}
+          AI_REVIEW_GATEWAY_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AI_REVIEW_GATEWAY_API_KEY }}
+          AI_REVIEW_MODEL: ${{ vars.AI_REVIEW_MODEL }}
+        run: node tools/review/main.mjs
